summary: Iteration 8: Full validation of Email Verification (6-digit OTP) + Password Recovery. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (register returns verified=false + JWT + code logged; verify-otp accepts correct code and rejects wrong ones; 5-wrong-attempts lockout works; resend cooldown 30s returns 429 within window and 200 after; forgot-password returns {ok:true} for both known and unknown emails (no enumeration); reset-password succeeds, invalidates the old password, allows login with the new password, and marks verified=true; admin info@maxenergy.com.au / maxenergy12@ logs in with is_admin=true & verified=true). Frontend: Full happy paths executed against public preview URL — Login shows [data-testid=forgot-password-link]; Register -> auto-routes to Verify screen; 'I'll verify later' lands on Home which shows the orange [data-testid=home-verify-banner]; tapping the banner reopens Verify; entering the log-scraped 6-digit code verifies the account and the banner disappears; Forgot Password 2-step flow (email -> code+new password) logs the user straight into Home. OTP codes were retrieved via `tail /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log` matching the regex 'OTP issued for <email> (verify|reset): <code>' as documented in the request.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: 'Unexpected text node: ) : (. A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Very likely caused by a stray whitespace/newline between a ternary and its JSX branches inside a <View> (or inside a <Pressable> whose child is treated as a View on web). Non-blocking (flows still work) but should be cleaned up — inspect ternaries around ActivityIndicator / Ionicons inside login.tsx, register.tsx, verify.tsx and forgot-password.tsx and ensure the `{loading ? (<ActivityIndicator/>) : (<Text>…</Text>)}` blocks contain no bare text nodes.

'"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — repo-wide, not specific to this feature. Consider migrating to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents in a future cleanup.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: hunt the stray text node inside a <View> that produces 'Unexpected text node: ) : (' console errors on auth screens — likely a formatting quirk around a ternary (e.g. an accidental space/newline outside JSX). Doesn't break functionality but is noisy.
OPTIONAL: migrate shadow* + props.pointerEvents to RN Web recommended equivalents (repo-wide, not blocking this feature).

OPTIONAL: /api/auth/resend-otp returns 429 even when the caller is a legitimate first-time-resend, which is expected per spec (30s cooldown). Consider surfacing the cooldown seconds in the response body so the client can display a countdown without hard-coding 30.
critical_code_review_comments: OTP verification correctly deletes the record on success and increments attempts on wrong code. Lockout kicks in on the 6th attempt (attempts>=5 check happens BEFORE bcrypt compare), so the correct code is rejected once the attempts counter reaches 5 — verified in test_verify_locks_after_5_wrong_attempts.

forgot-password never leaks account existence: both known and unknown emails return {ok:true} with 200. Reset-password additionally rejects Google-provider accounts (provider != password) with a generic 'Invalid or expired code' error — consistent no-enumeration behavior.
reset-password sets verified=true on the user in addition to changing the password, and invalidates any existing session tokens (db.user_sessions.delete_many). Good security hygiene.

AuthContext.registerEmail stores the token & user immediately after /api/auth/register so the newly-registered (unverified) user is 'soft-gated' logged in — matches product requirement (a). Verify screen calls refresh() after successful OTP so the user object updates to verified=true and the Home banner disappears (confirmed in UI test).
Frontend api.ts hardcodes API_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (no default) — correct pattern; will fail fast if env is missing.
